item.title: Why I’m glad I’m graduating before they renovate Warren Towers | The Senior Scaries
item.description: Warren Tower A is projected to be done by fall 2026 and the full construction is set to finish in summer 2028. As a senior graduating in May, the closer Warren gets to being done with construction, the closer graduation is. While I’m excited for what comes next, it’s hard to not be a little nostalgic for the life I’ve established here at BU.

item.title: Title Town Takes: Spring Training is underway for the Red Sox, while Jayson Tatum inches closer to return to the Celtics
item.description: With the Red Sox playing their first Spring Training games, Opening Day is officially in sight. This should be a very intriguing season for Boston.

item.title: Quinn Nielsen is the embodiment of Terrier Basketball

item.title: The prediction market controversy and why the Trump administration is embracing it | Beyond the Ballot
item.description: The past year has seen a dramatic rise in online prediction markets, catalyzed by a major inflection point in the 2024 election. item.title: Today is Student Press Freedom Day. Here’s what it means to me.
item.description: Student press freedom deserves to be celebrated every day. As a student journalist who makes it everyone’s business, I am biased toward this — and I feel the only way to express my feelings about it is to, of course, write about it in my university’s independent student newspaper.
